name: Pablo Macchi
headline: Calipso Managing Director
about:
Experienced Consulting Practice Director with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Sales, and Oracle & PeopleSoft. Strong consulting professional with a Master's Certificate in Project Management focused in Project Management from The George Washington University School of Business. 

With about 30 years experience in the IT industry, Pablo has successfully delivered on multiple roles in Consulting and Developmente Positions – Practice Management, Project Management, Functional & Technical Consultant, Projects Delivery & Technology consulting. Director of Product Development & Cloud Infraestructure.

He also has a rich experience in managing multiple projects and bids covering the Project Implementation lifecycle He is an accomplished IT professional with vast experience in all projects phases. He has extensive hands on experience and expertise in Project Management, and software engineering. He also has a good experience in Quality related processes and CMMi process mapping and involved in Internal Quality audits. 

Pablo is a Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by Project Management Institute (PMI), USA.

- The team consisted of 44 professionals who reported directly to Pablo and were distributed between Argentina, Mexico and Brazil with the profiles of Project Managers, ERP & CRM Functional Consultants and Programmers.
- Adoption of best practices and support for the incorporation of agile methodologies such as SuiteSuccess (fast implementation, bundled, with the use of accelerators and initial configuration).
- Support in the estimation of professional services, internal negotiation with the licensing teams.
- Serving the first clients in Latin America.
- Project manager for clients with escalation, weekly executive follow-up meetings.
- Responsible for P&L, annual budget compliance, savings and resource optimization.
